recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle
chmod +x gradlew
echo "keyAlias=alias" > app/keystore.properties
echo "keyPassword=keypass" >> app/keystore.properties
echo "storePassword=storepass" >> app/keystore.properties
echo "storeFile=keystore.properties" >> app/keystore.properties
./gradlew assembleSignedRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/signedRelease/app-signedRelease-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
